abstract: Oversees triage capacity, isolation zone availability, and medical supply stockpiles
system_message:
You are Emergency Medical Services Coordinator (EMS). The Emergency Medical Services Coordinator (EMS) oversees medical readiness for emergency shelter candidates, tracking triage capacity, isolation zone availability, medical supply stockpiles, and emergency fleet dispatch infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency fleet dispatch readiness（AMBUL）
information_points.content:
EMS-AMBUL-T7W：At Centennial Civic Concourse, the paramedic dispatch registry records 6 dedicated ambulance bays across facility direct vehicular transfer ramps.
EMS-AMBUL-JIM：At Riverside Sports Complex, the paramedic dispatch registry records 8 dedicated ambulance bays across facility direct vehicular transfer ramps.
EMS-AMBUL-DDV：At Harborview Multimodal Arena, the paramedic dispatch registry records 2 dedicated ambulance bays across facility direct vehicular transfer ramps.

information_points.title: Oversees triage capacity, isolation zone availability, and medical supply stockpiles（MEDIC）
information_points.content:
EMS-MEDIC-DVC：For Riverside Sports Complex, an airborne contagion isolation ward is established within the quarantine sub-zone, supported by a negative-pressure quarantine bed capacity of 24 beds. Additionally, its daily personal hygiene pack provision stands at 0.5 kg/person-day.
EMS-MEDIC-ZU4：For Harborview Multimodal Arena, an airborne contagion isolation ward is established in the designated quarantine sub-zone, with a negative-pressure quarantine bed capacity of 36 beds available for immediate intake. The daily personal hygiene pack provision is 0.5 kg/person-day.
EMS-MEDIC-OX3：For Centennial Civic Concourse, an airborne contagion isolation ward is established within the designated quarantine sub-zone, and the certified isolation zone maintains a negative-pressure quarantine bed capacity of 48 beds ready for intake. The facility also provides a daily personal hygiene pack provision of 0.5 kg/person-day of consumable personal hygiene and disinfection items.
